@about: Harness and cabinet wiring add-on (0.8 SU.892). Words of the add-on only.
col.name: Name
note.sleeve: Length of the segments; sleeving or tape by the metre
cmd.hwire.help: Give wires an id, colour, gauge, type, end treatments, a length or a note
cmd.hnum.help: Number every wire that has no id yet
cmd.hharn.help: Draw a harness: nodes and segments (B starts a branch from a node)
cmd.hend.help: Tie devices to a node of a harness drawing
cmd.hroute.help: Route every wire through the harness and count the wires in each segment
cmd.hpanel.help: Draw the back panel of a control cabinet
cmd.hmod.help: Put the schematic's devices on a rail (* places every one that is left)
cmd.hfromto.help: The from-to list: print it, or draw it as a table
cmd.hcut.help: The wire list with cut lengths and totals
cmd.hconn.help: The connector tables: every pin and its wire
cmd.hbundle.help: The harness segments with their length, wires and diameter
cmd.hbom.help: The bill of materials: wire, wire ends, devices, rails, ducts
ask.harn.pick: Click a harness drawing to add to it, or Enter for a new one
ask.harn.name: Harness name
ask.end.tags: Devices at {node} (tags, or a terminal strip like -X1): {list}
